programme.desc: Succesul reproductiv este esențial pentru supraviețuirea oricărei specii de păsări, iar în acest episod vedem patru specii de păsări care fac eforturi extraordinare ca să găsească parteneri și să-și crească puii, dând generației următoare cea mai bună șansă la viață. Oriunde trăiesc, aceste păsări au de lucru, trebuie să-și apere teritoriul de invadatori, să atragă parteneri valoroși și să-și ocrotească puii.

programme.title: Misterele fluviului Mekong
programme.desc: Delta fluviului Mekong este una dintre cele mai mari de pe Terra. Formată în ultimii 8.000 de ani, se extinde și se varsă în Marea Chinei de Sud prin nouă brațe. Aceste brațe divid și modeleauă coasta, creând habitate unice pentru o varietate de animale.

programme.title: Câini cu meserii extraordinare
programme.desc: Facem cunoștință cu un border collie care protejează avioanele de coliziuni letale cu păsări, cu un sprocker spaniel al cărui simț olfactiv salvează șobolani de apă și cu un ciobănesc din Anatolia care ajută la conservarea celei mai ocrotite feline mari din Africa, ghepardul.

programme.title: Câini cu meserii extraordinare
programme.desc: Cunoaștem un Golden Retriever care ameliorează anxietatea și ajută la vindecarea de SSPT, un ciobănesc care ajută la salvarea supraviețuitorilor de alunecări de teren, o pereche de cockeri spanieli care miros scurgerile de apă subterane și un grup de animale de companie din Marea Britanie care ajută copiii să învețe să citească.

programme.title: Ținutul umbrelor
programme.desc: Coasta de sud-est a Noii Zeelande este una dintre cele mai bogate zone de pescuit din lume - locul în care animalele marine tinere fac tranziția de la stadiul de novice la cel de adult independent. Balenele, delfinii și focile tinere învață să vâneze, învață regulile societății sau pornesc în propriile lor aventuri.

programme.title: Povestea elefanților: Orfanii de la Reteti
programme.desc: Hai în Sanctuarul de Elefanți Reteti, unde mamele surogat dau lecții de supraviețuire și îngrijesc elefanții tineri. Cunoaște-l pe Long'uro fără trompă, și află de ce boala misterioasă a lui Kelele, de șase ani, i-ar putea întârzia eliberarea.

programme.title: Povestea elefanților: Orfanii de la Reteti
programme.desc: Urmărește durerea despărțirilor și speranța pentru viitor, când o generație de elefanți salvați este în sfârșit eliberată. Bun venit noilor membri ai familiei Reteti, un pui de elefant salvat dintr-o adăpătoare și o zebră traumatizată pe nume Kisima.

programme.title: Creaturi ciudate
programme.desc: Veți fi martori la viața celor mai ciudate din ocean. Să te uiți în ochii unui pește bou-de-mare poate fi o experiență șocantă (la propriu), iar prădătoarele care speră să doboare un crevete-păun vor fi împiedicați de cleștii săi ca niște menghine.

programme.title: Regatele ascunse ale Africii
programme.desc: Cea mai mare parte din an e deșert, dar în august și septembrie, văile prăfuite din Namaqualand se transformă într-un teritoriu al minunilor, plin de flori sălbatice. Sunteți martorii acestei transformări magnifice din deșert arid în oază superbă.

programme.title: Secrete arctice
programme.desc: Mlaștinile din golful Hudson fac parte din cea mai mare zonă mlăștinoasă din America de Nord. Peste 300.000 kmp de teren mlăștinos, o vastă întindere plină de bălți, cât vezi cu ochii, cu turbă îmbibată de apă, mușchi și copaci piperniciți. Considerată cândva o sălbăticie pustie, acum știm că această zonă mlăștinoasă e foarte importantă pentru viața pe Terra. La nivel global, mlaștinile conțin la fel de mult dioxid de carbon ca atmosfera. Ecosistemul turbăriei e cel mai eficient rezervor de carbon de pe planetă.

programme.title: Secrete arctice
programme.desc: Yukonul este o veritabilă regiune sălbatică, una dintre ultimele de pe Terra. Acest ținut vast poartă numele celui mai lung fluviu al său, pe care populația băștinașă gwich'in o numește "Yu-kun-ah" sau "marele râu". Al treilea curs de apă ca lungime din America de Nord, fluviul Yukon curge prin văi largi și prin canale înguste, pe 3.000 de km spre nord-est, către Marea Bering cea asaltată de furtuni.

programme.title: Secrete arctice
programme.desc: E noiembrie la capul Tatnam. În josul coastei vestice a golfului Hudson vine iarna. Dar gheața care ar trebui să se formeze deja pe golful Hudson nu se vede nicăieri. Anul 2016 a fost cel mai cald de până acum. La sfârșitul lui noiembrie, temperatura e mai mare cu zece grade decât media. Schimbarea climei face prăpăd în nord. La o temperatură de doar câteva grade sub zero, apa oceanului nu îngheață.

programme.title: Scufundări în Australia
programme.desc: Explorați malurile nordice și apele abundente ale Marii Bariere de Corali. Înfruntați străzi inundate, crocodili de mare înfometați și meduze letale alături de Lizzie, care investighează motivul pentru care în această zonă există atât de multe creaturi ciudate și letale.

programme.title: Scufundări în Australia
programme.desc: Luați-vă adio de la tropice și răcoriți-vă în apele sudului. Faceți cunoștință cu rechinii infirmier gri, sepiile care își schimbă forma și balenele albastre uriașe, jucați-vă cu pingurinii și leii de mare și aflați de ce aceste mări sunt atât de pline de viață.

programme.title: Scufundări în Australia
programme.desc: Parcurgeți ultima tură a călătoriei prin ținuturile neîmblânzite ale Australiei, în care deșertul interior întâlnește oceanul Indian. Înfruntați provocările supraviețuirii în această regiune alături de Lizzie, care face scufundări alături de rechini tigru, pisici de mare și țestoase nomade.

programme.title: Urgențe în sălbăticie
programme.desc: Tim face o cursă pentru a salva pe koala Ashley, apoi o vulpe zburătoare cu un deget în plus are nevoie de atenție din partea lui Martine. Calculați șansele pentru un pui de cangur rătăcit cu Emily, apoi sărbătoriți eliberarea a 50 de lorikete.

programme.title: Păsări sălbatice din Australia
programme.desc: Urmăriți povestea lui Hally și a lui Sally, o pereche de mici pinguini. Aceste păsări care nu pot zbura, înzestrate cu înotătoare, formează unele dintre cele mai zgomotoase adunări de animale din natură. Aici se desfășoară o saga familială a relațiilor fidele, a gospodăritului dedicat și a unei vieți nocturne însuflețite.

programme.title: Păsări sălbatice din Australia
programme.desc: Emul este cea mai mare pasăre nativă din Australia și este a doua cea mai mare pasăre din lume, după struț. Este înalt de doi metri, cu pasul lung de aproape trei metri, și complet incapabil să zboare. Această pasăre trăiește o existență în care toate sunt pe dos, femeile sunt dominante, ouăle sunt verzi, iar masculii fac toată munca legată de producerea și creșterea micilor pui, numiți "Dungații".

programme.title: Păsări sălbatice din Australia
programme.desc: Păsările de pradă din Australia se numără printre cele mai crunte prădătoare din această regiune. Acești ucigași foarte specializați sunt puternici, ingenioși și uluitori; folosesc arme impresionante pentru a supraviețui. Aceasta este povestea vânătorilor aerieni din Australia.

programme.title: Păsări sălbatice din Australia
programme.desc: Succesul reproductiv este esențial pentru supraviețuirea oricărei specii de păsări, iar în acest episod vedem patru specii de păsări care fac eforturi extraordinare ca să găsească parteneri și să-și crească puii, dând generației următoare cea mai bună șansă la viață. Oriunde trăiesc, aceste păsări au de lucru, trebuie să-și apere teritoriul de invadatori, să atragă parteneri valoroși și să-și ocrotească puii.

programme.title: Cer sălbatic
programme.desc: Diversitatea climatică din America de Sud alimentează forme și mai diverse de viață. Urmăriți copacii care respiră oxigen din pădurea tropicală amazoniană, arcul unui vast râu de nori și flamingo în razele arzătoare ale soarelui.

programme.title: Latura sălbatică a Lunii
programme.desc: Vezi cum fazele lunii stabilesc ritmul unei lupte nesfârșite între prădător și pradă. Plutește alături de colugo, savurează un festin cu fructe de mare alături de macaci și vezi o haită de lei care încearcă să transforme în cină un pui de elefant.

programme.title: Latura sălbatică a Lunii
programme.desc: Vizitează o lume a romantismului și a aventurii. Îndrăgostește-te de dansuri de împerechere, vezi o pereche de vulpi polare, plutește printre pești într-un recif de corali și vizitează bazinele luminate de lună ale broaștelor fierar.

programme.title: Latura sălbatică a Lunii
programme.desc: Pornește în călătorii epice ghidate de forțe lunare. Vezi cum semnale invizibile ghidează balenele și țestoasele de-a lungul rutelor din ocean, străbate continente alături de caprimulgi și vezi gândaci și alte insecte care navighează la lumina lunii.

programme.title: Supraviețuirea fiarei
programme.desc: Urmăriți cimpanzeii din Ruanda cu Max, care încearcă să convingă aceste maimuțe puternice că le este prieten. Aflați câteva sfaturi cheie pentru a mânca în junglă și urmăriți o dinamică familială complexe, inclusiv îngrijirea și socializarea.

programme.title: Supraviețuirea fiarei
programme.desc: O privire în lumea neînfricatului urs buzat, adesea neînțeles. Călătoriți în Sri Lanka cu Max și aflați cum acest animal fioros se luptă cu leoparzii și alți rivali mortali, încercând în același timp să adune suficiente proteine pentru a supraviețui.

programme.title: Supraviețuirea fiarei
programme.desc: Prin jungla din Sri Lanka cu leopardul, maestru al camuflajului. Vedeți cum s-a adaptat această formidabilă felină de vânătoare la climatul cald și uscat de pe insulă, apoi descoperiți cele mai bune trucuri pentru urmărirea și prinderea căprioarelor.

programme.desc: Diversitatea climatică din America de Sud alimentează forme și mai diverse de viață. Urmăriți copacii care respiră oxigen din pădurea tropicală amazoniană, arcul unui vast râu de nori și flamingo în razele arzătoare ale soarelui.

programme.title: Creaturi ciudate
programme.desc: Evoluția le-a acordat unor animale un avantaj distinct asupra adversarilor lor. Investigați mutațiile perfecte ale unor părți ale corpului care le-au conferit caracatițelor-wunderpus, salamandrei axolotl, lopătarul-regal și ai-ai-ul și altor animale un avantaj.

programme.title: Prietenii uimitoare între animale
programme.desc: Acest episod din "Prietenii uimitoare între animale" prezintă o rață care nu vrea să intre în apă fără să o ducă prietenul ei, un câine, un elefant care se crede bivol și o cireadă de vaci care adoptă o căprioară orfană.

programme.title: Prietenii uimitoare între animale
programme.desc: Acest episod din "Prietenii uimitoare între animale" prezintă o rață care nu vrea să intre în apă fără să o ducă prietenul ei, un câine, un elefant care se crede bivol și o cireadă de vaci care adoptă o căprioară orfană.

programme.title: Prietenii uimitoare între animale
programme.desc: Aflați despre alte "Prietenii uimitoare între animale", făcând cunoștință cu Charlotte, un schnautzer care adoră să facă baie împreună cu prietenul său, porcușorul de Guinea numit Wallace, și un berbec zvăpăiat pe nume Hamish, căruia îi place să se furișeze ca să stea cu o cireadă de vaci de lapte, în loc să rămână alături de ai săi.

programme.title: Prietenii uimitoare între animale
programme.desc: În acest episod din "Prietenii uimitoare între animale", un rinocer orfan, salvat, se împrietenește cu un câine jucăuș și cu o oaie grijulie, un iepure mare care are grijă de niște miei neastâmpărați și un porc spinos care ajută doi buldogi englezi să pună pe picioare animale rănite.

programme.title: Prietenii uimitoare între animale
programme.desc: Aflați despre alte "Prietenii uimitoare între animale", făcând cunoștință cu un cățeluș de la un adăpost care ajută un pui de ghepard captiv să se pregătească pentru viața în sălbăticie, precum și cu o maimuță rănită care înfruntă o haită de câini dușmănoși și cu o mangustă căreia îi place să caute hrană alături de o turmă de oi.

programme.title: Prietenii uimitoare între animale
programme.desc: Acest episod din „Prietenii uimitoare între animale” prezintă o ceată de maimuțe de la un adăpost care au adoptat câțiva pisoi de pripas, un câine loial care ajută un raton salvat să-și depășească fricile și un emu crescut de niște setteri irlandezi.

programme.title: Prietenii uimitoare între animale
programme.desc: Acest episod din "Prietenii uimitoare între animale" ni-l prezintă pe Barclay, "directorul fermei", un mare danez care este un talentat îmblânzitor de cai. În Africa, un mic saguin pe nume Thor a devenit obsedat cu doi pui de mangustă salvați.

programme.title: Misterele fluviului Mekong
programme.desc: De la orezării îngrijite până la pădurile tropicale sălbatice, fluviul Mekong este sursa vieții în estul Thailandei. Urmărește gibonii cum negociază dinamica familială și vezi cum vipera aduce pericol pentru rețelele fragile de viață din regiune.

programme.title: Misterele fluviului Mekong
programme.desc: Străbătută de apele Mekongului, Cambodgia este definită prin relația sa cu acest fluviu. Află de ce țara este un punct fierbinte pentru biodiversitate și explorează refugiile secrete ale animalelor care supraviețuiesc în habitatele sale naturale.

programme.title: Misterele fluviului Mekong
programme.desc: Mekongul este sursa de apă a Cambodgiei, mai ales în timpul sezonului uscat și torid, când umezeala este greu de găsit. Află cum tot felul de creaturi zburătoare, de la păsări la lilieci, gestionează resursele până când sezonul ploios aduce alinare.

programme.title: Misterele fluviului Mekong
programme.desc: Ultimul ținut din călătoria fluviului Mekong este regiunea deltei uriașului fluviu. Un depozit amplu de substanțe nutritive bogate, purtate în aval de la sute de kilometri fac din această zonă neprețuită din Vietnam o comoară biologică.

programme.title: Misterele fluviului Mekong
programme.desc: Delta fluviului Mekong este una dintre cele mai mari de pe Terra. Formată în ultimii 8.000 de ani, se extinde și se varsă în Marea Chinei de Sud prin nouă brațe. Aceste brațe divid și modeleauă coasta, creând habitate unice pentru o varietate de animale.

programme.title: Asemenea oamenilor: Cimpanzeii din Fongoli
programme.desc: Alătură-te antropologului Jill Pruetz și îndrumă-l pe Dondo (Johnny) Kanté ca să vezi evoluția în timp real. Urmărește cimpanzeii din Fongoli folosind unelte, interacționând cu focul și adaptându-se la lumea oamenilor.

programme.title: Școala din junglă a orangutanilor
programme.desc: Un nou trimestru promițător începe la Școala din junglă a orangutanilor din Borneo. Iată cum începătorul Bumi încearcă să se concentreze, Rumba face primii pași timizi spre independență, iar starul Valentino începe colegiul cu oarecare dificultăți.

programme.title: Școala din junglă a orangutanilor
programme.desc: Proaspătul absolvent Beni are parte de o primire emoționantă la colegiul din junglă împreună cu foștii colegi Sura, Meryl și Wine. Iată-le și pe nou-sosita Molly, respectiv pe Bumi și pe Monita care primesc note la ultimele lecții de la Dr. Nadine.

programme.title: Școala din junglă a orangutanilor
programme.desc: Compătimiți-l pe mâncăciosul Beni care primește o corecție de la masculul dominant, Petruk. Urmăriți cum răsfățatul Spanser, fost animal de companie, încearcă să-și tempereze pofta de dulciuri înainte ca rebelul Bumi să o ia razna împreună cu Greta.

programme.title: Școala din junglă a orangutanilor
programme.desc: Se acționează rapid pentru a izola cazul de malarie al orfanei Cesia, apoi se evaluează planul mamei-surogat Sri de a-l ajuta pe Bumi. Mama-orangutan din sălbăticie, Daput, influențează pozitiv femelele de la colegiu, iar stocul de hrană este atacat.

programme.title: Școala din junglă a orangutanilor
programme.desc: Suntem în căutarea lui Lahei, de la grupa mică, și urmărim cum timida Rumba își folosește mâna stângă la construirea unui cuib. Iată cum Delilah îl ajută pe Bumi la clasă, iar apoi aflăm dacă Beni și Valentino promovează și își dobândesc libertatea.

programme.title: Școala din junglă a orangutanilor
programme.desc: Să-i felicităm pe absolvenții Școlii din Junglă a Orangutanilor, care au crescut. Urmați convoiul către locul de eliberare, unde echipa spune un rămas-bun emoționant iar apoi se bucură de sărbători zgomotoase cu ocazia promovării lui Molly și Bumi.

Formatul permite interacţiunea directă între medicii invitaţi şi telespectatori prin intermediul telefonului şi a reţelelor sociale.

programme.title: Jurnal de viaţă
programme.desc: O emisiune despre excelența în profesia de medic, cu invitați profesioniști în domeniul medical, oameni care performează în acest domeniu. Formatul show-ului este acela de infodoc având linia narativă a unei biografii. Scopul emisiunii este acela de a-i apropia pe campionii domeniului de publicul telespectator, de a prezenta momentele de inflexiune din cariera acestora, performanţele profesionale, planurile de viitor, predincţiile acestora în ceea ce priveşte noile descoperiri şi tendinţe în domeniul lor de expertiză şi activitate.

programme.title: Academia de sănătate
programme.desc: Academia de Sănătate este un show informativ bazat, în mare parte, pe interviuri cu renumiți profesori universitari din domeniul medical. Subiectele emisiunii sunt de actualitate şi sunt menite să ridice misterul asupra unor boli cu notorietate și să facă lumină în ceea ce privește actul medical de calitate. Domeniul medical este unul vast din toate punctele de vedere şi de aceea considerăm că introducerea în grila de programe a emisiunilor de acest tip este una benefică pentru telespectatori. În această emisiune telespectatorii au posibilitatea să fie informaţi direct de la cei ce sunt responsabili de actul medical. Formatl show-ului va încuraja dezbaterile, iar finalul va fi uşor de comunicat.

programme.title: Underdog
programme.desc: Noua serie „Underdog şi Apărătorii Canini” urmăreşte aventurile unui supererou canin cu totul deosebit, care luptă împotriva criminalităţii. Neîndemânatic, dar îndrăgit, Underdog este un câine cu superputeri care se luptă cu răufăcătorii cu ajutorul echipei sale de supereroi. În ciuda personalităţii sale predispuse la gafe, bunătatea şi determinarea sa îl transformă într-un erou îndrăgit şi simpatic. Creată pentru un public de tranziţie, seria îmbină acţiunea şi umorul, promovând în acelaşi timp valori pozitive precum prietenia, curajul şi perseverenţa.

programme.title: GT World Challenge America 2025
programme.desc: GT World Challenge America is the premier North American GT series. Taking place on the best US circuits form Sonoma to Indianapolis, each of the seven race weekends features 90-min double-header races.

programme.title: FIM X-Trial World Championship 2025
programme.desc: The FIM X-Trial World Championship is an international indoor motorcycle trials championship that features some of the best riders in the world competing in highly technical and challenging obstacle courses. In X-Trial events, riders navigate through a series of sections that include obstacles such as rocks, logs, and other challenging terrain, aiming to complete the course with the fewest penalties.

programme.title: FIM Enduro World Championship 2025
programme.desc: The FIM EnduroGP World Championship delivers thrilling off-road action, with top riders battling on challenging courses with natural obstacles. A packed schedule showcases skill and excitement.

programme.title: FIM Supermoto World and European Championship 2026
programme.desc: The FIM Supermoto World Championship, also known as S1GP, is the premier international competition for Supermoto racing, first held in 2002. The championship focuses on the S1 class, showcasing high-speed races on mixed dirt and asphalt tracks, with riders performing jumps, slides, and fast cornering maneuvers.

programme.title: 4x4
programme.desc: By now, every car manufacturer offers a high potent compact sports car. They are the enjoyable riding machines amongst the A-Class, Golf and Co. Mercedes rejuvenates its A-Class. Now the top model, the Mercedes-AMG A45 4MATIC, produces 381 hp. Thus it confirmed it commitment to boast the most powerful four-cylinder in the world. The high performance car rocks the race track. Also on 4x4: The Audi RS3, the strong competitor from Ingolstadt. Compact Sports Cars With All-Wheel Drive on 4x4: The All-Wheel Magazine.

programme.title: Tuning
programme.desc: A lot of work, attention to detail and passion is packed into a tuned show car. But it might take some time until a car like this is ready to stand on its own four wheels. Dirk Hattenhauer and his crew still work on creating the most spectacular custom car of the entire European tuning scene. This time it's all about the wedding, which is held under difficult conditions.

programme.title: Stunt Heroes
programme.desc: A skidding lorry against a remote controlled family van. That`s the new story the Stunt Heroes realize on their private Autobahn. Stunt coordinator Christoph Domanski`s goal: to separate the roof from the rest of the car. If the plan works out, they will create a unique stunt convertible. A spectacular stunt test for Hollywood productions!

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: In 1964 Opel attacked the upper class. 50 years ago, the Russelsheimer factory brought out the Opel Kapitän, Admiral and Diplomat, short KAD. American style, solid German technology. Classic Ride presents three representative cars from the series, including an ultra-rare and extra elegant Diplomat Coupé.

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: Jaguar is not only the coolest car brand from Britain, but the coolest car brand in the world. While the manufacturer was founded as the Swallow Sidecar Company by Sir William Lyons in 1922, the first Jaguar premiered in 1935. Shortly afterwards the Jaguar SS 100 was introduced, which fascinated with its power, dynamics and elegance and thus paved the ways for models like the XK 120, the E-Type or the XJ. Car History showcases all the models from the SS 100 to the latest F-Type and looks back at Jaguar's success in motorsports.

programme.title: Motorheads
programme.desc: Portrait of Stephane Peterhansel, who is a famous rally driver from France and nine-time winner of the Dakar Rallye.

programme.title: Classic Races
programme.desc: Tropical temperatures, never-ending dust and curves: those are just some of the many difficulties for man and machine during the 1964 Grand Prix in Argentina. This race was responsible for taking the Mercedes brand to the top.

The decisive moment
programme.desc: In this episode, we will meet Giles Clarke, photojournalist. He has covered many areas of conflict and humanitarian crisis. He will tell us about the dangers of his work, the difficulties it presents, his motivations, and his views on the world around us and its crises.

programme.title: Sketchbook
programme.desc: Raphael Federici (street artist), Marine Goodmorning (illustrator), Luca Fiore (cartoonist) and Harry Boudchicha (drawing teacher) reveal their best drawing techniques. Each episode focuses on a specific subject:\r\nmovement, oil painting, shadows, hair... For the first 10 minutes, each artist gives a theoretical lesson illustrated by sketches. Then they each start working on their creation. Finally, they end with a debrief, comparing\r\nand explaining their techniques.

programme.title: Secret treasures
programme.desc: Secret treasures makes you discover the Thiers Library in Paris. It is a place that houses many treasures that we do not suspect the existence. Today, we will visit this exceptional place which is the property of the Institute of France in search of the treasures it contains. Experts, historians, librarians, will guide us through the corridors and floors of this magical place.

programme.title: Graffiti World
programme.desc: Graffiti World is a short program dedicated to contemporary urban art around the world. Each episode explores a specific city, highlighting iconic works of street art. Local soundscape accompanies the images for an authentic, commentary-free immersion. The program showcases the creativity and diversity of artistic expression in public spaces. An invitation to discover the richness of graffiti as an art form in its own right.

programme.title: Private Tour
programme.desc: Private tour takes you to discover the exhibition "Japan-japanism, inspired objects, 1867-2018" at the decorative arts museum. Japan began to be known around the 1850s and its art was quickly recognized. In this exhibition you will be able to observe Japanese objects, but also objects of Japanese influence which testify to the relations between France and Japan.

programme.title: Sketchbook
programme.desc: Raphael Federici (street artist), Marine Goodmorning (illustrator), Luca Fiore (cartoonist) and Harry Boudchicha (drawing teacher) reveal their best drawing techniques. Then they each start working on their creation. Finally, they end with a debrief, comparing\r\nand explaining their techniques.

programme.title: Artist's Workshop
programme.desc: In this episode we will meet the artist Christian Lapie. He is an artist who created works and installations that surprised and seduced the public. But in the mid-1990s, he abandoned his projects in search of a universal message. Since then, he has devoted himself to sculpture and has installed his statues all over the world.

programme.title: The Edge of Art
programme.desc: Art collector Andrew Wilson teams up with curator and experiential designer Courtney Hammond to explore the uncharted waters of NFTs in the art world. As they gain a greater appreciation of the metaverse, they challenge renowned Atlanta-based artists to create a piece in the NFT domain- a medium which most have never dared to delve into before.

programme.title: Graffiti World
programme.desc: Graffiti World is a short program dedicated to contemporary urban art around the world. Each episode explores a specific city, highlighting iconic works of street art. Local soundscape accompanies the images for an authentic, commentary-free immersion. The program showcases the creativity and diversity of artistic expression in public spaces. An invitation to discover the richness of graffiti as an art form in its own right.

programme.title: Museum Tour
programme.desc: In this episode we visit the city of Vallauris where Pablo Picasso became fascinated by the town and the ceramics after visiting an exhibition and it’s where he lived for a decade. The city remains forever marked by the work of this protean artist. Picasso is known in Vallauris for the chapel of the castle and its impressive cycle of paintings entitled "War and Peace". It is also in the museum of ceramics that some of the most beautiful works of the "potter" Picasso are exhibited. The sculpture of “Man with a Sheep”, placed on the Market Square, testifies to the artist's attachment to the city and its inhabitants. In 1959, the castle chapel was inaugurated with his masterpiece "War and Peace" just across the museum Magnelli.

programme.title: Origami
programme.desc: Origami is about the art of paper folding, a Japanese and Chinese millenary tradition. In modern usage, the word “origami” is used as an inclusive term for all paper folding, regardless of their cultural origin. Different folding and sculpting techniques, new models, bright colors – you’ll see all of this in our program! We will teach you how to transform a flat square sheet of paper into a finished sculpture – from simple to complex!

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Claude Monet is probably the best-known painter of the impressionist movement. Indeed, the term “impressionism” was derived from his painting “Impression Rising Sun” (1872). This exhibition retraces the great stages in Monet’s prolific career while dwelling on paintings of this master that cannot be ignored: the “Saint Lazare Station”, the “Poppies near Argenteuil”, the “Haystacks” and the “Rouen Cathedral” exposed all around the world in different museum such as the Museum of Fine Arts in Boston without forgetting his “Water-lilies” exposed at the Orangerie museum in Paris. \r\nEnjoy your visit!

programme.title: The decisive moment
programme.desc: In this episode, we'll be talking with Jennifer Khordi, photographer. She is a former computer professional from the Bronx. She started with street photography in the late 1980's and then moved into travel and portrait photography. She has spent the last few years photographing the moon, the Milky Way and New York City.

programme.title: Private Tour
programme.desc: Private Tour takes you to the discovery of the exhibition "Giacometti, between tradition and avant-garde" at the Musée Maillol. This exhibition shows how Giacometti evolved from style to style. It tells his story from the first busts he sculpted at the age of 13, to the realization of large-scale sculptures towards the end of his life.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Although Degas’ art is difficult to classify, it is often associated with the impressionist movement, which emerged in France at the end of the 19th century. Nevertheless, he developed a very personal style with a preference for indoors subjects rather than the open-air scenes favoured by the impressionist painters. The 10 masterpieces presented here are a good illustration of Degas’ preferred themes: the show, the bath, family portraits and the working classes.\r\nDiscover " The Ballet classe " exposed at the Orsay Museum or the " Blue Dancers " at the Fine arts Museum Pouchkine.\r\nEnjoy your visit!

programme.desc: Possibly the most renowned painter in the world, Vincent van Gogh was born in Holland in 1853 but spent most of his life in France. Suffering from mental instability, Van Gogh produced more that 2,000 paintings before committing suicide aged 37. You will discover during this visit some of his most famous masterpieces, in particularly two “Self-portraits” at the Orsay Museum, “Sunflowers” exposed at the National Gallery in London, “Starry Night” and the “Church at Auvers-sur-Oise”.\r\nEnjoy your visit!

programme.title: Othoniel Cosmos - An Artist in Avignon
programme.desc: Cosmos, an Artist in Avignon is a poetic documentary that follows Jean-Michel Othoniel during the creation of his monumental exhibition in Avignon (2025–2026). Through his perspective, the film explores the intimate genesis of his works, from conception to realization, from spirit to matter.\r\nStructured around the four elements, this sensory journey takes us from Jean-Michel’s studio in Montreuil to the workshops of the many artisans collaborating on the project, as well as to the iconic sites of Avignon. The city becomes a stage where the artworks integrate and dialogue with the spaces, between contemporary installation and historical heritage.\r\nThe journey culminates in a choreographic performance by Carolyn Carlson, created for Othoniel’s works and performed by Hugo Marchand and Caroline Osmont, presented for the first time in the courtyard of the Palais des Papes.

programme.title: Artist's Workshop
programme.desc: It is in the center of Buenos Aires that Eduardo Stupia decided to install his studio entirely dedicated to creation. In a 20th century house, wedged between two modern buildings, he occupies a large space in which he can indulge in his favorite art, drawing. His works, which he describes himself as abstract landscapes, are drawn with pencil, charcoal or Indian ink. In his heterogeneous compositions, where the graphic language and the precision of the gesture hold a central place, Eduardo Stupia explores the semantics of the drawing and opens the fields of the imagination.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Born in 1866 in Moscow, Wassily Kandinsky is considered as one of the most important 20th century artists. He was notably the founder of abstract art. Having left Russia for Germany where he started teaching at the Bauhaus in 1922, he then settled in France in 1933 and left behind him a particularly abundant work. You will rediscover here his most emblematic creations, essentially drawn from the collection of the Centre Pompidou in Paris.\r\nEnjoy your visit!

programme.title: Museum stories
programme.desc: The city of Boulogne Billancourt experienced rapid development in the interwar period. Industrialists, filmmakers, architects, painters and sculptors test their creativity there. It is this impetus that the Museum of the 1930s would have liked to transcribe, created a collection of works of art from this period, first constituted by purchases in galleries, flea markets or auction houses, then mainly by donations. More than 1,500 sculptures, 800 paintings, 300 pieces of furniture… A heterogeneous whole, testimony of an era and a place in which the artistic excitement unfolds, and opens the way to a number of creative adventures of the 20th century.

The contemporary and futuristic ideas influence his work from the beginning, based on its initial orientation on the past and the origins of humanity.

The “Fanciful Figure” exposed at the Louvre-Lens demonstrates an original and very modern style. Plaster, earth, sandstone and bronzes, but also sketches, variations and variations, reveal the process of development and the working method of an artist as fertile as inventive.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: A key artist of the Italian Renaissance, Raffaello Santi (1483-1520) developed a classical art form, based on drawing, which made him the model for many painters in the following centuries. His favourite theme was the Madonna: you can admire, for example, “The Sistine Madonna” in Dresden and the “The Virgin and Child with St John the Baptist” in the Louvre. Notice the gentle harmony and the delicate sensuality in “The Three Graces” or the powerful human presence in “The Portrait of Baldassare Castiglione”.\r\nEnjoy your visit!

Son of a carpenter who moved to the capital, Antoine Bourdelle became the most important official sculptor at the beginning of the 20th century. This pupil of Rodin took on numerous commissions in France and abroad. But he also kept some of his sculptures still present today in his workshop in the Montparnasse district, a magical place, which has remained frozen in the past.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: In the second half of the 19th century, Edouard Manet (1832-1883) showed great originality in his painting of historic scenes and portraiture of well-known figures, such as the novelist Zola and the poet Mallarmé. Even if we cannot call him the first Impressionist, his leading role in the history of modern art must be emphasised. The scandals in 1863 caused by “The Luncheon on the Grass” or “Olympia” both exposed at the Orsay Museum effectively mark the beginning of modern painting.\r\nEnjoy your visit!

programme.title: John Singer Sargent - Portraitist of Paradox
programme.desc:
From September 22, 2025 to January 11, 2026, following its presentation at The Metropolitan Museum of Art in New York, the Musée d’Orsay will devote a major exhibition to John Singer Sargent (1856–1925), marking the centenary of the painter’s death.
A century after his passing, John Singer Sargent—celebrated for his portraits of French, English, and American high society during the Belle Époque—remains an enigma. Beneath a façade of carefully maintained respectability, his work nonetheless shocked his contemporaries with its sensuality and candor. Idolized by a wealthy elite eager to pay a fortune to sit for him, another side of his oeuvre reveals his fascination with Bedouins, Spanish dancers, and Venetian gondoliers.
This film offers a portrait full of contradictions: an American born in Florence, we follow him from his nomadic childhood across Europe, through the salons of Paris and London, and finally to the United States, his homeland.
Although immensely successful during his life.

His portraits of Brad Pitt, Steve Carrel, Bradley Cooper and many others, are published in renowned magazines.

programme.title: Artist's Workshop
programme.desc: In this episode, we will meet the artist Ben. Active on the contemporary art scene for over 50 years, he is a self-taught, multi-faceted character. His success is undeniable. If his status as an artist is affirmed through his famous writings painted in white cursive letters on a black background, his temperament as a "jack of all trades" has made him one of the most avant-garde artistic personalities in the art world since the 1960s. Attached more than anything else to his region, the artist has been working and living for over 40 years in the heights of Nice, in Saint-Pancrace, in a house where each room can become a studio, and where the progressive lack of space has led him to create an extension, the doors of which he is now opening to us.

It is also in the museum of ceramics that some of the most beautiful works of the "potter" Picasso are exhibited. The sculpture of “Man with a Sheep”, placed on the Market Square, testifies to the artist's attachment to the city and its inhabitants. In 1959, the castle chapel was inaugurated with his masterpiece "War and Peace" just across the museum Magnelli.

programme.title: Within the frame

programme.title: Othoniel Cosmos - An Artist in Avignon
programme.desc: Cosmos, an Artist in Avignon is a poetic documentary that follows Jean-Michel Othoniel during the creation of his monumental exhibition in Avignon (2025–2026). Through his perspective, the film explores the intimate genesis of his works, from conception to realization, from spirit to matter.\r\nStructured around the four elements, this sensory journey takes us from Jean-Michel’s studio in Montreuil to the workshops of the many artisans collaborating on the project, as well as to the iconic sites of Avignon. The city becomes a stage where the artworks integrate and dialogue with the spaces, between contemporary installation and historical heritage.\r\nThe journey culminates in a choreographic performance by Carolyn Carlson, created for Othoniel’s works and performed by Hugo Marchand and Caroline Osmont, presented for the first time in the courtyard of the Palais des Papes.

programme.title: Artist's Workshop
programme.desc: It is in the center of Buenos Aires that Eduardo Stupia decided to install his studio entirely dedicated to creation. In a 20th century house, wedged between two modern buildings, he occupies a large space in which he can indulge in his favorite art, drawing. His works, which he describes himself as abstract landscapes, are drawn with pencil, charcoal or Indian ink. In his heterogeneous compositions, where the graphic language and the precision of the gesture hold a central place, Eduardo Stupia explores the semantics of the drawing and opens the fields of the imagination.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Born in 1866 in Moscow, Wassily Kandinsky is considered as one of the most important 20th century artists. He was notably the founder of abstract art. Having left Russia for Germany where he started teaching at the Bauhaus in 1922, he then settled in France in 1933 and left behind him a particularly abundant work. You will rediscover here his most emblematic creations, essentially drawn from the collection of the Centre Pompidou in Paris.\r\nEnjoy your visit!

programme.title: Museum stories
programme.desc: The city of Boulogne Billancourt experienced rapid development in the interwar period. Industrialists, filmmakers, architects, painters and sculptors test their creativity there. It is this impetus that the Museum of the 1930s would have liked to transcribe, created a collection of works of art from this period, first constituted by purchases in galleries, flea markets or auction houses, then mainly by donations. More than 1,500 sculptures, 800 paintings, 300 pieces of furniture… A heterogeneous whole, testimony of an era and a place in which the artistic excitement unfolds, and opens the way to a number of creative adventures of the 20th century.

programme.desc: In this episode, students will have to make photos for a jewelry brand. Other students will be tasked with photographing a composition with an object of disproportionate scale. We will also see a second year visual storytelling class.

programme.title: Graffiti World
programme.desc: Graffiti World is a short program dedicated to contemporary urban art around the world. Each episode explores a specific city, highlighting iconic works of street art. Local soundscape accompanies the images for an authentic, commentary-free immersion. The program showcases the creativity and diversity of artistic expression in public spaces. An invitation to discover the richness of graffiti as an art form in its own right.

programme.title: Raw Art: When one looks, one finds it!
programme.desc: This documentary travels to France to question the contours of Raw Art. Savine Faupin, curator of the department Art Brut at LAM, Matthew Morin, connoisseur and collector Christian Berst, owner of the eponymous gallery: each character tries to put his own definition of an art difficult to grasp. Indeed, Raw Art is constantly renewing itself, it is not limited by time or by the style and remains foremost vector emotional message.

programme.title: Sketchbook
programme.desc: Raphael Federici (street artist), Marine Goodmorning (illustrator), Luca Fiore (cartoonist) and Harry Boudchicha (drawing teacher) reveal their best drawing techniques. Each episode focuses on a specific subject:\r\nmovement, oil painting, shadows, hair... For the first 10 minutes, each artist gives a theoretical lesson illustrated by sketches. Then they each start working on their creation. Finally, they end with a debrief, comparing\r\nand explaining their techniques.

programme.title: We are Artists not Vandals
programme.desc: Today we meet Paella and Ludo Lebaron. Paella is a painter and street artist who works most of the time at Les Frigos, a place where artists, craftsmen and architects express themselves in Paris. Lebaron is a painter from the north. He has been practicing stencil art as a self-taught artist for a long time, and mixes text and image, the great poets of the past with our current social problems.

programme.title: The decisive moment
programme.desc: In this episode, we will discuss with Spencer Tunick, an American visual photographer. He is known for his photographic compositions featuring hundreds of volunteers, men and women, posing nude, mostly in urban settings. He does not define himself as a photographer, but as a creator of installations, the photos being only the representation of his works.

programme.title: Graffiti World

An invitation to discover the richness of graffiti as an art form in its own right.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: A native of the southern French town of Grasse, Jean-Honoré Fragonard is one of the most important 18th century French painters. He studied at the French Academy in Rome but chose to be free in his work, preferring to carry out private commissions, some of which were licentious, such as “The Shirt Withdrawn” exposed at the Louvre. The “Fanciful Figure” exposed at the Louvre-Lens demonstrates an original and very modern style. One of his masterpieces is without doubt the painting “The Bolt”, in the collection of the Louvre in Paris.\r\nEnjoy your visit!

programme.title: Private Tour
programme.desc: Private Tour takes you to the discovery of the exhibition " Split air – Bamboo art in Japan " at the Quai Branly Jacques Chirac Museum. Bamboo art in Japan appeared quite late but continues today thanks to contemporary artists. Throughout this exhibition we will be able to observe works from different periods of this movement.

programme.title: Francis MESLET silence photographer
programme.desc: Francis Meslet travels the world in his spare time in search of abandoned places, shrines on which the time has stopped after the man has voluntarily closed doors or not. It brings back vivid images, time capsules indicating a parallel universe for escape of the mind and questioning ....

An invitation to discover the richness of graffiti as an art form in its own right.

programme.title: Artist's Workshop
programme.desc: In this episode, we will meet the artist Annette Messager. Her creations have been shaking up the contemporary scene for almost 50 years. She is one of the greatest French artists, awarded a Golden Lion at the Venice Biennale in 2005. She uses fabric and everyday objects to represent the intimate. But she also remains a committed artist. Installed in the popular suburbs of Paris, Annette Messager welcomes us in her workshop.

Local soundscape accompanies the images for an authentic, commentary-free immersion. The program showcases the creativity and diversity of artistic expression in public spaces. An invitation to discover the richness of graffiti as an art form in its own right.

programme.title: Street Art - They Own the Day
programme.desc: From “simple” tags to gigantic, colorful murals and collages, street art that was once suppressed is now officially open to the eye of the beholder. When did this shift take place? How do artists themselves experience this change in status and perception? Has their approach evolved along with their art?\r\nTo tell these stories, we've come up with a fabulous playground: Laon's International Urban Arts festival.

Then they each start working on their creation. Finally, they end with a debrief, comparing\r\nand explaining their techniques.

programme.title: The decisive moment
programme.desc: In this episode, we meet Cheryl Dunn, photographer. After moving to New York City in the mid-1980s, she spent much of her career photographing the city's streets and the people who made their mark on them. In the late 1990s, she began to focus on film, creating classic films about artists of her generation who influenced the realities of urban life through their own work.

programme.title: Private Tour
programme.desc: Private Tour takes you to discover the exhibition "The Pushkin Museum: five hundred years of master drawings" at the Fondation Custodia in Paris. The works are displayed in such a way that visitors can observe the evolution of drawings over five centuries. There are drawings by the Italian artist Frederico Zuccari (or Zuccaro) but also the Dutch artist Peter Paul Rubens.

programme.title: Museum stories
programme.desc: In the heart of the Montparnasse district, the Bourdelle Museum remains one of the last testimonies of these groups of artists which flourished in Paris at the threshold of the 20th century. The Antoine Bourdelle Museum offers an opportunity to see the work being created it, as close as possible to the material, in the museum's workshop spirit. Plaster, earth, sandstone and bronzes, but also sketches, variations and variations, reveal the process of development and the working method of an artist as fertile as inventive.

programme.title: Origami
programme.desc: Origami is about the art of paper folding, a Japanese and Chinese millenary tradition. In modern usage, the word “origami” is used as an inclusive term for all paper folding, regardless of their cultural origin. Different folding and sculpting techniques, new models, bright colors – you’ll see all of this in our program! We will teach you how to transform a flat square sheet of paper into a finished sculpture – from simple to complex!

Different folding and sculpting techniques, new models, bright colors – you’ll see all of this in our program! programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: A key artist of the Italian Renaissance, Raffaello Santi (1483-1520) developed a classical art form, based on drawing, which made him the model for many painters in the following centuries. His favourite theme was the Madonna: you can admire, for example, “The Sistine Madonna” in Dresden and the “The Virgin and Child with St John the Baptist” in the Louvre. Notice the gentle harmony and the delicate sensuality in “The Three Graces” or the powerful human presence in “The Portrait of Baldassare Castiglione”.\r\nEnjoy your visit!

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: Based on a major exhibition at the Ashmolean Museum in Oxford, Tokyo Stories spans 400 years of incredibly rich art, from Hokusai’s prints to Pop Art posters, via contemporary photography, manga, cinema and street art. The exhibition was a huge success and attracted a significantly younger and more diverse audience than usual. The film draws on the exhibition to take us to Tokyo and explore the city’s art and artistic figures in greater depth. A superbly illustrated and richly detailed documentary, which traces the journey of a metropolis marked by ceaseless cycles of destruction and rebirth throughout its 400-year history, to become one of the most dynamic and fascinating cities in the world today.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Caspar David Friedrich (1774-1840) is a German Romantic painter who concentrated mainly on landscape art, which he rendered in minute detail. He was rediscovered at the end of the 19th century. A melancholy character, he peopled his canvases with human figures seen from behind, contemplating the enormity of nature, for example in his famous “The Wanderer above the Mists” in Hamburg or the “Chalk Cliffs on Rügen”. Notice his superb landscapes with their twilight tones.\r\nEnjoy your visit!

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: “Happiness is an angel with a serious face.” These words by the Italian painter Amadeo Modgliani define to perfection the portraits which made him famous… He reinvented the icon, with his oval faces, his elongated necks and lapis-lazuli eyes which are strangely expressive even when robbed of substance. You will be able to appreciate the simplicity of his figures, the restraint in his lines and colours, especially when you admire “The Woman with the Blue Eyes” or the “Portrait of Anna Zborowska”. Enjoy your visit!

programme.title: Sketchbook
programme.desc: Raphael Federici (street artist), Marine Goodmorning (illustrator), Luca Fiore (cartoonist) and Harry Boudchicha (drawing teacher) reveal their best drawing techniques. Each episode focuses on a specific subject:\r\nmovement, oil painting, shadows, hair... For the first 10 minutes, each artist gives a theoretical lesson illustrated by sketches. Then they each start working on their creation. Finally, they end with a debrief, comparing\r\nand explaining their techniques.

programme.title: Little Sketches
programme.desc: In 64 episodes, fun and educational, you will know how to draw an airplane, a fireman, a haunted mansion, a soccer player, a sunset, a lion, the Eiffel Tower, seashells, a fairy... Our master draftsman Gia-Haï Phan will show you the basics of a successful drawing: proportions, perspectives, values, contrasts, volumes, blending, everything is covered.

programme.title: Architectures
programme.desc: Adalberto Libera was one of the most important figures in twentieth-century architecture, and also one of the most emblematic: he was both a pioneer of architectural modernity and a convinced Fascist, innovative architect and architect of the regime. Unlike the Nazis, Mussolini allied himself with the modern movement, which became the official architectural style of Fascism. In 1937, the regime launched one of its most ambitious projects: the E 42. The aim was to create a new monumental city for the 1942 International Exhibition, embodying the new Imperial Rome.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: This eagerly-awaited exhibition at the Royal Academy of Arts was the first-ever retrospective devoted to the portraiture of Édouard Manet. Covering the entire career of this enigmatic and sometimes controversial artist, the exhibition brought together works from Europe, Asia and the United States. Manet's portraiture has never been the subject of an exhibition, although it represents around half of his artistic output. He painted his family, friends and the literary, political and artistic figures of the day, bringing to life not only his subjects but also Parisian society.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: David Hockney, generally considered one of Britain's most popular artists, has enjoyed worldwide success throughout his life, with exhibitions in London, New York, Paris and elsewhere attracting millions of visitors. This film reveals intimate, previously unseen interviews and focuses on two successful exhibitions that took place in 2012 and 2016 at the Royal Academy of Arts in London.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: Hopper’s work is the most recognisable art in America – popular, praised, and mysterious. Countless painters, photographers, filmmakers and musicians have been influenced by his art – but who was he, and how did a struggling illustrator create such a bounty of notable work?\r\nThis new film takes a deep look into Hopper’s art, his life, and his relationships. From his early career as an illustrator; his wife giving up her own promising art career to be his manager; his critical and commercial acclaim; and in his own words – this film explores the enigmatic personality behind the brush….

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Discover some of Georges Seurat's works created at the end of the 19th century. These works are exhibited in Paris, Troyes or London. They include carefully carved stones similar to commemorative steles, Tibetan statuettes and numerous period objects.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Simultaneously painter and diplomat, Peter Paul Rubens, (1577-1640) was an essential personality in Europe’s 17th century artistic scene. He painted vast compositions for princely families of the time like the Marie de Medici cycle now housed in the Louvre Museum. He also personified the baroque vein in Northern Europe, developing a style of perpetual movement with luminous coloured strokes as in the “Rape of the Daughters of Leucippus” exhibited in Munich.\r\nEnjoy your visit!

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc:
Pop Icon and actress Claire Grogan is reunited with fellow Glaswegian, Taggart actor Alex Norton as they battle it out in the search for profitable antiques. Anita Manning and Paul Laidlaw are on hand to lend their expertise. 

Anita and Alex find themselves on an Antiques ‘Boat’ Trip as they reminisce about childhood trips down the Clyde. While Claire and Paul see firsthand what Stirling castle would’ve looked like in the 16th century. 

The result of the auction in Ayr all rests on a naked lady.

programme.title: Rothko – Hartung: Colors and Cataclysms
programme.desc: While Europe and the United States dominate the art scene after World War II, Mark Rothko and Hans Hartung forged a discreet, friendly and very fertile bond. This documentary introduces the discovery of this little known and fascinating complicity between both artists. On the one hand, Mark Rothko, "the most violent of American painters" in his own words; on the other, Hans Hartung, a brilliant experimenter and "boxer" in front of the canvas. From the moment they met in 1950 in Hans Hartung's studio, there was a collaboration between them that resulted in huge, metaphysical and cataclysmic paintings. Then, Rothko gave a "lesson" to his European colleague, Hartung visited and paid homage to his elder and then mourned his suicide from Antibes, where he had a huge villa-studio built and kept the secrets of his relationship. This Rothko-Hartung encounter is an unprecedented and yet essential subject to understand a part of 20th century art.

programme.title: Warning ! Fresh paint
programme.desc: Move along, there's nothing to see! In April 2018, the Museum "La Piscine de Roubaix" prepared to expand its exhibition space. In a period of six months, several thousand works had to be unhooked, dusted, restored, moved, and reinstalled. These are unique works for which any handling required extreme precautions. Bruno Gaudichon, curator and founder of the museum, had to employ and bring together several workers in ordert to complete a successful reopening.

programme.title: St+art India
programme.desc: In the heart of India, Bombay welcome the festival ST+ART, one of the most big urban arts festival in the country. Discover the backstage of the event and understand the relation between the habitants, artists and monumental murals.

programme.title: Private Tour
programme.desc: Private Tour takes you to discover the second exhibition of "Japanese Raw Art" at the Halle Saint Pierre. With this exhibition, we try to question and understand what makes the success and originality of raw art. Among the works on display you will be able to discover works by the iconic Japanese artist Sawada who participated in the Venice Biennale in 2013.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: The National Gallery of London is offering a fresh look at arguably one of the greatest artists of all – Johannes Vermeer, painter of the famous Girl with a Pearl Earring. In an exhibition entitled ‘Vermeer and Music: The Art of Love and Leisure’, The National Gallery has chosen to focus on Vermeer’s relationship with music. It is one of the most popular themes of Dutch painting and reveals an enormous amount about this most fascinating of artists.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: Wilhelm Hansen was a visionary businessman who lived in Denmark in the 19th century. He was one of the few collectors to take an interest in the Impressionist painters, at a time when they were attacked and denigrated. The film takes us to Hansen's summer home on the outskirts of Copenhagen, and to the extraordinary exhibition of his collection at London's Royal Academy.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc:
Two stars of the seventies, cool crooner Tony Christie and pop royalty Jimmy Osmond are accompanied by experts Catherine Southon and Margie Cooper. Blasting off from the Leicestershire town of Loughborough they’ll head for an auction in the Staffordshire city of Stoke-on-Trent. 

Tony squeezes in a visit to Coalbrookdale, the place where ground breaking techniques were developed that kick-started the industrial revolution. And petrol-head Jimmy gets to whizz round the historical race circuit at Donington. 

The big auction finale includes a sing-a-long like no other. But which musical maestro will clinch victory?

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Two luvvies from the world of stage and TV, Ruth Madoc and Su Pollard, best known for their appearances in sitcom Hi-De-Hi, are antique hunting with Phil Serrell and Raj Bisram. Setting off from the Welsh border town of Monmouth they head for auction in Congleton, Cheshire. \r\nRuth also gets to find out about the incredible 19th century nurse – and it’s not Florence Nightingale – whilst Su visits ancient Roman town Caerleon and finds time for an amphitheatre showdown with Phil. \r\nAnd Su attempts to resolve an age old mystery...does Phil wear a wig?

programme.title: China - Masters of the Arts
programme.desc: While the hieroglyphs of Egypt and the cuneiform of Babylon have disappeared, Chinese calligraphy, also graphic and non-alphabetic, has endured through the ages. Of divinatory origin, Chinese characters carry not only a language but a unique way of thinking. A 84th-generation descendant of one of Confucius’s best-known disciples, calligrapher Yan Gongda unrolls before our camera the timeless story of a writing art closer to painting than graphology. Through this story, the entire history of China is told.

programme.title: Travelers
programme.desc: Today, Travelers takes you to Copenhagen, Denmark, whose name means "the merchant's port". First, we will go to Tivoli Gardens, the oldest amusement park in the world. Then we will go to the city center where we will visit the Church of Our Savior, known for its spiral bell tower. We will talk about design, which is almost a religion in Denmark, but also about Danish gastronomy, and many other things.

programme.title: John Singer Sargent - Portraitist of Paradox
programme.desc:
From September 22, 2025 to January 11, 2026, following its presentation at The Metropolitan Museum of Art in New York, the Musée d’Orsay will devote a major exhibition to John Singer Sargent (1856–1925), marking the centenary of the painter’s death.
A century after his passing, John Singer Sargent—celebrated for his portraits of French, English, and American high society during the Belle Époque—remains an enigma. Beneath a façade of carefully maintained respectability, his work nonetheless shocked his contemporaries with its sensuality and candor. Idolized by a wealthy elite eager to pay a fortune to sit for him, another side of his oeuvre reveals his fascination with Bedouins, Spanish dancers, and Venetian gondoliers.
This film offers a portrait full of contradictions: an American born in Florence, we follow him from his nomadic childhood across Europe, through the salons of Paris and London, and finally to the United States, his homeland.
Although immensely successful during his life.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: In June 2017, a major exhibition opened in Paris at the Musée d'Orsay. For the first time, this exhibition brought together all Cézanne's portraits. This was an opportunity to analyze Cézanne's work with the help of international experts and to tour the rooms of the National Portrait Gallery in London and the National Gallery of Art in Washington.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: The National Gallery in London is one of the world’s greatest art galleries. It is brimming with masterpieces, an inexhaustible treasure trove of history and an endless source of stories. This film gives a voice to those whose lives have been touched by the Gallery, from the security guard to the director, including daily visitors, celebrities and members of the royal family. Claudia Winkleman, Michael Palin, Terry Gilliam, Jacqueline Wilson and Her Royal Highness Princess Eugenie reveal their deeply personal connection to the National Gallery.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Pieter Bruegel the Elder, (1525-1569) is one of the most renowned Flemish painters of the Renaissance. Although influenced by Italian art, his paintings maintained a typically Flemish tradition. A “peasant” painter, he depicted the lives of his country’s common folk as in the “Peasant Wedding”. In “Netherlandish Proverbs”, he wittily transcribes dozens of popular sayings. Admire also his incomplete “Tower of Babel”, a theme which Bruegel made into his own speciality.\r\nEnjoy your visit!

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Discover or rediscover Chaim Soutine's masterpieces, each one more surprising than the last.

programme.title: Architectures
programme.desc: The Unal house was designed by Claude Häusermann-Costy and built by Joël Unal between 1972 and 2008. Like many French people, Mr. and Mrs. Unal dreamed of living in a detached house. A classic program, the family home, leads to a singular result - a bubble house built without any right angles. A single construction technique is used for all the volumes of the house: a concrete veil without formwork, hand-laid on a metal frame.

programme.title: Artist's Workshop
programme.desc: In this episode, we will focus on the gardens of Giverny. Marcel Proust was so fond of the gardens of Giverny, created by Claude Monet, not far from Paris. However, the author of the novel "Du côté de chez Swann", never saw the gardens. This shows the imagination that these gardens unfold, even though they were skilfully designed for more than 40 years by the master of the place, Claude Monet.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc:
Two legends of British comedy, Ronni Ancona and Jan Ravens are joined on this Road Trip by antiquers Phil Serrell and James Braxton. Starting in the North Yorkshire town of Redcar they’ll head for auction in Stockport in Cheshire. 

Jan gets rather carried away and spends every single penny of her entire budget. While Ronni gets a kick out of a very kitsch glass boot. 

A quick detour sees Jan find out why Hartlepudlians thought a monkey was a Frenchman and Ronni is left open mouthed when Braxton takes off his clothes. Crikey!

programme.title: Photo Contest
programme.desc: In this episode, the two candidates Sylvain Paulet and Martial Hadmar will have one hour to confront each other on an imposed theme. Today the theme is complicated because they will have to photograph the Astria waste recycling plant in Bordeaux and make it look good.

programme.title: Artist's Workshop
programme.desc: In this episode, we will meet the artist Tania Mouraud. This artist is a key figure in French contemporary art. Her work takes on very different forms, while remaining based on a real social commitment and ontological questioning. She mobilizes the viewer's awareness of himself and the world in which he finds himself.

programme.title: An hour with...
programme.desc: Take an hour break to discover the work of a Italien painter, Leonardo da Vinci.\r\nYou will discover his labour with the Joconde, Salvator Mundi, The Cène.

programme.title: An hour with...
programme.desc: Take an hour break to discover the work of a Netherlands painter, Rembrandt.\r\nYou will discover his labour with The night round, the return of the prodigal son, Danaé.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: John Singer Sargent is known as the greatest portrait artist of his era. What made his ‘swagger’ portraits remarkable was his power over his sitters, what they wore and how they were presented to the audience. Through interviews with curators, contemporary fashionistas and style influencers, Exhibition on Screen’s film will examine how Sargent’s unique practice has influenced modern art, culture and fashion.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Francisco de Goya (1746-1828) is a Spanish painter and engraver. He introduced several stylistic breaks that initiated Romanticism and announced the beginning of contemporary painting. His works include easel paintings, murals, engravings and drawings. We will discover works such as “Self-portrait with glasses”, “The sleep of reason produces monsters” or “The young ones”.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Leader of the School of Pont-Aven, Paul Gauguin, the most exotic of French artists, paved the way for modern painting. There were two main themes which marked his work: Brittany and Tahiti. A rebel, he rejected copying reality in favour of exploring more delicate painting techniques. You will discover here the most important milestones in his work: from “Four Breton Girls” to “Tahitian Women on the Beach”, by way of the surprising “Self Portrait with Yellow Christ”. Enjoy your visit!

programme.title: Sketchbook
programme.desc: Raphael Federici (street artist), Marine Goodmorning (illustrator), Luca Fiore (cartoonist) and Harry Boudchicha (drawing teacher) reveal their best drawing techniques. Each episode focuses on a specific subject:\r\nmovement, oil painting, shadows, hair... For the first 10 minutes, each artist gives a theoretical lesson illustrated by sketches. Then they each start working on their creation. Finally, they end with a debrief, comparing\r\nand explaining their techniques.

programme.title: Little Sketches
programme.desc: In 64 episodes, fun and educational, you will know how to draw an airplane, a fireman, a haunted mansion, a soccer player, a sunset, a lion, the Eiffel Tower, seashells, a fairy... Our master draftsman Gia-Haï Phan will show you the basics of a successful drawing: proportions, perspectives, values, contrasts, volumes, blending, everything is covered.

programme.title: Architectures
programme.desc: In 1050, one of the first major pilgrimage churches in the Western world was built at Conques, in the middle of the wild Aveyron landscape. This was the birth of "Romanesque" architecture. The abbey church - i.e., a church belonging to an abbey - at Conques is one of the most important structures built in 11th-century France. Its coherence, its location - a small village in the Rouergue region, far from the main medieval traffic routes - its innovative aspect, its state of preservation and the fact that the relics for which it was built are still in situ, make the church at Conques the best work of art for approaching Romanesque architecture in France. In other words, to try and understand how architecture was made at that time in our history, and to dismantle not only the building itself, but also a number of preconceived ideas about Romanesque art, starting with its very name, which is an intellectual construct of the 19th century, or to put it another way: those who built Conques.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: In 2013, Norway celebrated the 150th anniversary of the birth of Edvard Munch (1863-1944), one of the most prominent figures in modern art. Munch 150, co-produced by the National Museum and the Munch Museum, is already being hailed as "the exhibition of a lifetime". Public interest is enormous, as evidenced by the record-breaking $120 million public auction result for one of his four paintings, The Scream. This presentation will take you behind the scenes of how this exhibition came to be, as well as including a guided tour of Norway, outlining the biography of this man whose life spanned the mid-19th century to the German occupation during the Second World War.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: Exhibition on Screen takes us through the streets of Paris and then to the heart of a superb exhibition at Cambridge's Fitzwilliam Museum, whose impressive collection of Degas works is the most representative in Britain. Having benefited from exclusive access to a wide variety of rare works, the film tells the story of Degas' quest for perfection through experimentation.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: With loans from across the world, this major retrospective brings together Vermeer’s most famous masterpieces including Girl with a Pearl Earring, The Geographer, The Milkmaid, The Little Street, Lady Writing a Letter with her Maid, and Woman Holding a Balance. In all, 28 of his surviving 37 works. This film invites audiences to a privileged view of the exhibition, accompanied by the director of the Rijksmuseum and the curators of the show. A truly once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to discover the genius of Vermeer and his fascinating and mysterious life.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Discover some of the works of Georges Seurat realized during the end of the 19th century. These works are exhibited in Paris, Troyes or London.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: The Musée d’Orsay, originally a railway station built in Paris for the 1900 World’s Fair, houses European artworks dating from 1848 to 1914. Numerous artistic styles are on display: academism, realism, symbolism, Art Nouveau and of course, impressionism with world famous works such as Manet’s “Olympia”, Renoir’s “Ball at the Moulin de la Galette”, Degas’ “The Star on Stage” and Seurat’s “Circus”.\r\nEnjoy your visit!

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Top presenting pals Nicki Chapman and Jules Hudson escape to the country to find antiques with Natasha Raskin and Phillip Serrell. It becomes girls versus boys, both teams with £400 in their pockets. Kicking off from Wormsley in Herefordshire they Road Trip into Wales and Oxfordshire, before finally finishing in North Finchley, in London for an auction.\r\n\r\nAlong the way the girls meet a clog maker who carves shoes by hand. While the boys head to the Herefordshire Light Infantry Museum to hear about the regiment’s involvement at Gallipoli.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: In June 2017, a major exhibition opened in Paris at the Musée d'Orsay. For the first time, this exhibition brought together all Cézanne's portraits. This was an opportunity to analyze Cézanne's work with the help of international experts and to tour the rooms of the National Portrait Gallery in London and the National Gallery of Art in Washington.

programme.title: John Singer Sargent - Portraitist of Paradox
programme.desc:
From September 22, 2025 to January 11, 2026, following its presentation at The Metropolitan Museum of Art in New York, the Musée d’Orsay will devote a major exhibition to John Singer Sargent (1856–1925), marking the centenary of the painter’s death.
A century after his passing, John Singer Sargent—celebrated for his portraits of French, English, and American high society during the Belle Époque—remains an enigma. Beneath a façade of carefully maintained respectability, his work nonetheless shocked his contemporaries with its sensuality and candor. Idolized by a wealthy elite eager to pay a fortune to sit for him, another side of his oeuvre reveals his fascination with Bedouins, Spanish dancers, and Venetian gondoliers.
This film offers a portrait full of contradictions: an American born in Florence, we follow him from his nomadic childhood across Europe, through the salons of Paris and London, and finally to the United States, his homeland.
Although immensely successful during his life.

programme.title: Private Tour
programme.desc: Private Tour takes you to discover the exhibition "Jean-Jacques Lequeu - Builder of fantasies" at the Petit Palais. This exhibition is dedicated to the work of the late 18th century architect Jean-Jacques Lequeu. Despite his profession, he was not known for his constructions, but for his drawings. He made many portraits or drawings of everyday objects, architectural diagrams.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: Discover the work of Matisse through the exhibitions at Tate Modern in London and MoMA in New York (2014) and enjoy the original performance of Royal Ballet star dancer Zenaida Yanowsky, who interprets the colors and dynamism of Matisse's painting to the jazz music of Courtney Pine. Punctuated by interviews with experts and rare archival footage of Matisse at work, this documentary will provide a special insight into the last chapter of the painter's career.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc:
Without Camille Pissarro, there is no Impressionist movement. He is rightfully known as the father of Impressionism.

It was a dramatic path that Pissarro followed, and throughout it all he wrote extensively to his family. It is through these intimate and revealing letters that this gripping film reveals Pissarro’s life and work.

Born in the West Indies, Pissarro found his passion in paint as a young man in Paris, and by the age of 43 had corralled a group of enthusiastic artists into a new collective. Their first show was scorned by the critics, but the group had acquired a new name: the Impressionists. For the next 40 years Pissarro was the driving force behind what has today become the world’s favourite artistic movement.

The Ashmolean Museum has a long tradition of excellence. As the UK’s first ever public museum (it opened its doors in May 1683) it houses a wonderfully rich collection, including the remarkable Pissarro archive. With exclusive access to most extensive archive of.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Vocal coaches and husband and wife David and Carrie Grant are swapping singing in harmony for battling it out with antiques. With the help of experts Will Axon and Mark Stacey our competitive celebrity couple uncover some unusual items to sell at auction in rural Norfolk.\r\n\r\nDavid also visits a patch of inner-city grass in Cambridge where today children play and dogs are walked but was actually the birthplace of football, while Carrie learns how Letchworth Garden City sparked a revolution in town design.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Top Italian cooks Antonio Carluccio and Gennaro Contraldo are on a Road Trip around East Anglia. Restaurateurs, writers and old friends the ‘greedy Italians’ will be foraging for antiques in the company of experts David Harper and James Braxton. \r\nWatch out for some ‘explosive’ bargaining and an extremely tasty risotto! When he’s not shopping Antonio learns about the brave fisherman of Suffolk who saved mariners’ lives while risking their own. And, Gennaro has a trip to take a peek at a very special bird.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Comedy legend Jennifer Saunders and best pal, top actress Patricia Potter take to the road on a humdinger of a trip. Joined by veteran antiquers Phillip Serrell and Mark Stacey they shop in Berkshire, Hampshire and Oxfordshire before heading for an auction in Greenwich, London. \r\nJennifer and Phil detour to hear about Fred Karno, the man credited with inventing slapstick comedy. While Patricia and Mark learn how a surgeon from Reading used his incredible sense of smell to successfully treat soldiers injured in World War One.\r\nAnd, Phil gets custard pied – what’s not to love?

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc:
Prog rocker Rick Wakeman and best mate Ian Lavender, loved as Pike from Dad’s Army, enjoy a jolly B-road ride around Norfolk. In the company of experts Raj Bisram and David Harper the two antique hunting celebrities scour the county for treasure to take to auction in Nottingham.

Rick also uncovers some hidden medieval graffiti in Norwich Cathedral while Ian detours to north Norfolk to see the world’s largest collection of model soldiers. 

But, will an wise old Japanese man help Ian win at auction?

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc:
Two stars of the seventies, cool crooner Tony Christie and pop royalty Jimmy Osmond are accompanied by experts Catherine Southon and Margie Cooper. Blasting off from the Leicestershire town of Loughborough they’ll head for an auction in the Staffordshire city of Stoke-on-Trent. 

Tony squeezes in a visit to Coalbrookdale, the place where ground breaking techniques were developed that kick-started the industrial revolution. And petrol-head Jimmy gets to whizz round the historical race circuit at Donington. 

The big auction finale includes a sing-a-long like no other. But which musical maestro will clinch victory?

An incredible haul of antiques, including chimney pots, Pinocchio and a pair of African fertility figures, go under the gavel at an auction in Tewkesbury, Gloucestershire.

programme.title: Artist's Workshop
programme.desc: In this episode, we go to the center of Berlin. This is where the artist Maria Volokhova has set up her studio. An artist who navigates the border between art and design, Maria Volokhova is fascinated by the interior of the human or animal body. She creates functional porcelain objects for everyday life, but she is dedicated above all to the aesthetics of her art.
